question: Which group of oilfields among the following is located in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digboi and Naharkatiya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Digboi** and **Naharkatiya** are prominent oilfields located in** Assam, India**.
 
• Digboi is known for having the **oldest oil refinery in India**, which dates back to the late 19th
